A Foot in Two Worlds

You greet a stranger in the words of another home, smiling as they answer in the same tongue.

Rules

Know two additional ordinary spoken @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b65e9644d24629f2.JournalEntryPage.0237eee3512bbfa9]{languages}. Choose the communities that taught you; this does not grant a second culture’s discipline or card.

Ancestry: Human · Choice: one of your two traits · Action: Passive unless the effect says otherwise.

Duration: While its stated circumstances apply; permanent for base statistics.

ID: trait-human-many-homes
